ruling.recommended_action: Raise a fare-review credit of $1.44 (Ryde voucher, NS-7) for the unexcused 1.02 km detour segment; note the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach on file. No account flag (driver has no upheld route dispute in 90 days).

segment_findings.reason: Early off-route loop ~18:35:20–18:38:50 around the Marina East area (~1.0–1.3 km) that leaves the quoted route and returns at the ECP corridor (1.2797,103.8594). No chat message of any kind (chat is empty), so no rider consent under RD-5; no traffic incident matches the replaced Tanjong Pagar/ECP stretch at that time (RD-4). RD-3 inapplicable (no rider-requested stop). Unexcused detour under RD-1; extra_km enters the RD-2 refund.

Mid-trip detour ~18:53:50–18:58:20 off the ECP corridor near 1.3040,103.9103 / 1.3017,103.9098. The trace loses about 9 km/h and turns off right after the LTA 'Vehicle breakdown on East Coast Parkway' incident at 1.31236,103.95178 reported 18:27 (RD-4(a)) — a DataMall incident on the replaced best route, reported before the segment and within 300 m matching distance — so the driver's 'whole road was slow, took another way' is corroborated for this segment and it is not counted as a deviation.

rejected_claims.reason: The LTA breakdown incident (ECP, 1.31236/103.95178, 18:27) is on the route and exempts only the later segment (RD-4(a)); it is roughly 5 km and > 25 minutes away from the early Tanjong Pagar/Marina deviation, which has no incident or speed-band support. The driver's blanket claim of a road closure is therefore rejected for the early segment.

Correct as a fact (chat empty, no rider message), but it does not by itself entitle the rider to the full quoted-vs-meter difference; only the unexcused measured extra distance (1.02 km) is refundable under RD-2, not the entire 2.36 km discrepancy.
